enrichmentGuidance.note: Add NEW verified samples (commit a LabVIEW report HTML -> correlationReport.mjs -> buildViChangeMlDataset.mjs -> re-run this manifest). openResiduals lists task/config scores < 1.0 = the specific gaps to target.

navigation.note: benchmark.timeline maps every cycle and dead-gap event to 12 & 18 fps frame numbers and epoch ms. To find the screenshot for an event: frame = round((event.startEpochMs - benchmark.timeline.t0EpochMs) / 1000 * fps); filename = sprintf(benchmark.timeline.screenshotPattern, frame). To correlate a performance-monitor sample: match by epoch ms. To locate an event by symptom, scan benchmark.timeline.events (sorted by time) for kind=dead-gap with encapsulationCandidate=true (idle/optimization windows) or kind=cycle by description.

benchmark.note: benchmark excludes the manifest-writing cycle (its meta is written after this runs)

optimization.note: encapsulationCandidates are between-cycle gaps >= deadTimeThresholdSec: wrap that work in an Invoke-Cycle so it is measured. deadFraction is the share of wall-clock spent outside any cycle.

timeline.purpose: Fit a constant-FPS screenshot stream to wall-clock: assemble frames into a video with ffmpeg, and let an LLM navigate event -> frame -> screenshot and correlate to a performance-monitor time series (all keyed by epoch ms).
timeline.frameForEpochMs: frame = round((epochMs - t0EpochMs) / 1000 * fps)  // 0-based, continuous capture from t0

ffmpeg.fps12: ffmpeg -framerate 12 -start_number 0 -i frame_%06d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf fps=12 session_12fps.mp4
ffmpeg.fps18: ffmpeg -framerate 18 -start_number 0 -i frame_%06d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf fps=18 session_18fps.mp4

timeline.perfMonitorCorrelation: each event carries startEpochMs/endEpochMs; bisect a performance-monitor time series by epoch ms to find the sample(s) spanning an event, and map the same epoch ms to a video frame via frameForEpochMs.

mprrAlignment.note: The AUTHORITATIVE frame<->timestamp fit and perf correlation is the GOVERNED mprr Mirror-Mode pipeline, not this constant-fps cycle-level approximation. 12 fps is the mprr default (MPRR_DEFAULT_FRAME_RATE_HZ); this timeline shares that fps + the epoch-ms axis so it overlays the mprr artifacts.

governedModules.perfFrameSync: src/reporting/mirror/perfmonMprrSync.ts buildPerfmonMprrSync (vi-history-suite/perfmon-mprr-sync@v1) -- maps each perfmon sample to an mprr frameIndex + stopwatch + 100ns tick + bit-exact strip; authoritative only when calibrated
governedModules.groundTruthClock: src/dev/timingStopwatchSurface.ts renderLiveTimingStopwatchHtml (VHS-REQ-713.6) -- full-viewport 40-bit decodable stopwatch captured at >=12fps; each frame self-encodes centiseconds (decodeMprrStripImage), so frames carry their own timestamp rather than assuming constant fps
